title: 06 Advanced
subtitle: Nothing deleted — Advanced inside each panel, the menu, Menu › Diagnostics, Settings › Advanced; ⌘K finds it all and opens it all, once
brief: advanced mode — "nechci mazat zadne tools nebo akce pripadne debug tools jako sync atd. Klidne to nekam schovat do menu abych se k tomu dostal ale opravdu nic nemazat" — "Advanced separately in each panel". No sticky switch: a disclosure at each panel's foot, Menu › View › Advanced, Menu › Diagnostics (+ Advanced), Settings › Advanced, Search ⌘K, and a one-shot ⌘K “Open all Advanced sections”. The map lists all 124 things visible today that left the default view; each row names the artboard that draws its new home (115 here, 7 in other v2 canvases, 2 not drawn yet). Trash is not among them — it stays the Canvases panel's last row.

artboards.label: 1 · The map — 124 things, each with its home
artboards.note: Sankey from 13 places in today's app to 15 homes in v2, then the full ledger; every row carries the artboard that draws its home (→ N here, → NN · id elsewhere, or not drawn yet). Resync's ribbon is highlighted; the two rows not drawn yet are tinted amber.

artboards.label: 2 · Why there's no Advanced mode switch
artboards.note: A sticky switch floods every panel; a fold where you are keeps the app calm. Six fast paths, incl. ⌘K Open all Advanced, once.

artboards.label: 3 · One thing, end to end — Resync
artboards.note: Was a Sync panel header button → Menu › Diagnostics › Advanced (and ⌘K “resync”) → compares and sends/fetches, conflicts kept → toast, Saved, a log line.

artboards.label: 4 · Inspector › Advanced
artboards.note: All plain rows stay; the fold adds tag, classes, selector, id, Shared · 4 places + Detach, bound tokens, raw CSS, Copy style/CSS/code. Artboard: 08's sections (exact size, resolution, colour, guides, in code) + look and layout.

artboards.label: 5 · Canvases and Layers › Advanced, and Trash
artboards.note: Trash is the Canvases panel's last row and is listed in Canvases › Advanced (as 11). Advanced adds file names, hidden files, row menu (Reveal in Finder, Open in editor, View code), folder, design system; Layers adds tags, ids, select-by-selector. Tree = the kit's Alligators tree.

artboards.label: 6 · AI chat panel › Advanced (short)
artboards.note: Model, effort, fast mode, Ask before (Replace or move to the trash), show in chat, image/video/voice settings from the old Generate dialog, context, 5-hour limit, session, raw log, Open in terminal. Long version: 03 · ai-advanced.

artboards.label: 7 · Share › Advanced
artboards.note: The 10 · co-share-advanced sheet; Invite stays primary; Advanced adds link rules, the app and this-Mac links, GitHub invite and the hub it syncs to.

artboards.label: 8 · Timeline › Advanced, at its foot
artboards.note: Fold at the foot (07 · ve-advanced): ruler in frames, 07's timecode, keyframes; video settings, the selected keyframe's curve, the cut as code.

artboards.label: 9 · Export › Advanced
artboards.note: Scope, format, size, save-to up front (as 09); Advanced: exact scale, dpi, sRGB · Display P3, the {canvas} — {artboard}@{scale} file names, the command and /design:export. Exports panel; Print PDF: RGB — the print shop converts to CMYK. Other formats: 09 · ex-formats.

artboards.label: 10 · Version history › Advanced — the git, folded
artboards.note: Closed: versions, Compare, Restore — no commit ids. Open: branch, drafts, remote, the version's commit id and files, diff, git actions incl. Pull a copy.

artboards.label: 11 · The design system view
artboards.note: Was S and the DESIGN SYSTEM tree section: from Canvases › Advanced or ⌘K; colours, type, specimens; folder, tokens and MAUDE-DSN/01 under its Advanced.

artboards.label: 12 · Menu › File, View › Advanced, Help
artboards.note: CONTRACT §1 menus (View: Assets, Present the canvas, Advanced › Keep timeline open ⇧⌘T) with the rows that took in today's menu-bar items marked: Back to Home, Open project, imports, Handoff, Comments count, Present the canvas, View › Advanced toggles, Help.

artboards.label: 13 · Menu › Diagnostics, Advanced open
artboards.note: Sync, Server, AI setup in words; Logs, Reload canvas, Check AI setup again; Address, Process, Project folder, Resync now, Download all under Advanced.

artboards.label: 14 · Logs, Server, AI setup
artboards.note: A filterable log; Server keeps the status bar's live dot, version, mode stamp and port; AI setup check incl. where Claude Code was found.

artboards.label: 15 · Sync details — the old Sync panel, whole
artboards.note: Get latest; conflict Keep mine · Use theirs · Keep both; unfinished AI edit Publish · Discard; transfers with Cancel; counts; Sign in again; terminal hints under Advanced.

artboards.label: 16 · Settings › Advanced
artboards.note: This Mac (version, Restart now for an update, port, keys), Claude Code (incl. SVG agent and brand import commands), engines with whisper and Gemma model cards, privacy, this project's sync rules, experimental, reset.

artboards.label: 17 · Pin panels to the side
artboards.note: Docked left panel and inspector with drag handles; each keeps its Advanced at the foot.

artboards.label: 18 · ⌘K and ? — find any hidden tool
artboards.note: Search results carry their home path; the ? sheet's Advanced holds only View › Advanced / Diagnostics keys plus every key that moved.

artboards.label: 19 · “Advanced mode” as a one-shot — Open all
artboards.note: ⌘K “advanced” → Open all Advanced sections: every fold opens once, nothing stays switched on; Close all is its inverse.

artboards.label: 20 · The canvas as code, read-only
artboards.note: View code with the selected artboard's lines marked; Open in editor; terminal and Claude Code commands under Advanced.

artboards.label: 21 · Sync problem — words first, details folded
artboards.note: Status says Syncing… (CONTRACT §6); 3 changes waiting, safe on this Mac, one verb Try now; hub, reply code and waiting files under Advanced.

artboards.label: 22 · A canvas whose code is broken
artboards.note: One sentence and Ask AI to fix it; the error, line 212, an excerpt, Open in editor and the last good version under Advanced.

artboards.label: 23 · A project on a self-hosted hub
artboards.note: The window says Saved like any cloud project; address, token and hub version only under that connection's Advanced.

artboards.label: 24 · In the browser, comment-only, local, offline
artboards.note: Proposed: in cloud.maude.sh Reveal in Finder → Open in the Mac app, Diagnostics → Runs in the cloud, this-Mac link and terminal hidden; comment-only, local and offline columns say what hides or greys.

artboards.label: 25 · The remembered fold
artboards.note: Inspector › Advanced opened Monday is open Tuesday; Canvases kept its own; Settings › Advanced › Reset lists what's open and closes all.
